text_to_sequence: convert a string of text to a sequence of symbol IDs using cleaner names
sample_code_chunk: sample a random contiguous chunk of a given size from a discrete code array
code_to_sequence: convert a list of discrete codes to a sequence of IDs using a code dictionary
sequence_to_text: convert a sequence of symbol IDs back to a readable text string
sequence_to_code: convert a sequence of IDs back to discrete codes using a code dictionary
